method.nominal_frame: Frame completion QPC minus delta_us through the retained affine QPC/UTC-to-ETL mapping.
method.clipping: Every state segment is intersected with the nominal frame.
method.coverage: Per-thread union of precise-row state segments; residual remains unknown rather than being assigned to a scheduler state.
method.cross_thread_sums: Threads overlap; sums are CPU-thread time and are not wall time or a critical path.
method.dominant_unnamed: Highest nominal sampled weight among threads with blank ETW name; no main/UI identity is asserted.
method.old_thread_columns: Old State/Old Wait Reason were excluded because they describe the switched-out old thread.

alignment_limit.statement: The affine map pins both retained boundary pairs and preserves frame duration, but adjacent QPC/GetUtcNow call latency was not measured. Sub-millisecond point alignment is not claimed.

extraction.context_window_note: The wider extraction context is not fully bounded for every thread and is not used for quantitative findings.

observations.interpretation_limit: Ready transitions are scheduler observations; they are not counted as notifications, PTIMER callbacks, or OS wakeups.
